gotchas: This node is the union of the whole color package plus GradientPresets.kt, which lives in the theme package because presets consume a derived scheme. A change to GradientPresets.kt makes this node stale, not the theme node.
Selection and focus are resolved through their own sets rather than through the border set, so a role lookup for a boundary role branches separately from the surface and content groups.
A status role carries both a status meaning and a slot, and the scheme resolves it from those two fields, so adding a status means adding entries rather than new when branches.
OKLCH has no alpha channel: the conversion out drops it and the conversion in takes alpha as a separate argument, so round-tripping a translucent color loses its alpha.
The ink-picking helper returns pure black or pure white only, choosing whichever contrasts higher; it is not a tinted ink.
Conversion back to BasisColor clamps each channel into sRGB, so out-of-gamut OKLCH values silently lose chroma.
All categorical colors generated for one mode share a single chroma, the maximum across the seed hues floored at the tuning minimum, so seeds of differing chroma do not stay distinct on that axis.
Categorical indices past the end of the seed hue list do not wrap: they rotate the last seed by the golden angle, so a short seed list silently extends rather than repeating.
The gradient value type is a plain description of stops and direction, not a Compose brush; the main library is expected to map it.
The brand gradient preset bakes in a 30 degree hue rotation and a 0.75 chroma factor as literals in the preset rather than as tuning fields.

invariants.rule: The color files never import the theme package; the dependency runs the other way
No concrete brand or palette values: the package defines roles and engines, not presets

Contrast thresholds are the WCAG AA constants, not numbers written at call sites

gotchas: Immediate is modelled as its own timing rather than as a zero duration, because a zero-length animation still schedules frames and completes asynchronously whereas Immediate completes at the point of application.

A resolved motion may hold several tracks that start, end and cancel together while keeping independent durations and curves, so a renderer must treat the list as one motion instance rather than as separate animations.
Reduced motion is an input to resolution rather than a Motion token, so there is no reduced-motion token to override; it is a constraint on the resolver.
Timings use Int milliseconds and Float spring parameters, so the package is not uniformly typed.
Every timing constructor and BasisResolvedMotion validate their arguments with require, so an invalid duration or spring parameter fails construction rather than surfacing later at animation time.
The tracks of a resolved motion are plain data, not Compose animation spec types, so mapping them to a platform is the renderer's job.

invariants.rule: The motion vocabulary names intent only; duration, easing, spring behaviour and property choice are resolution details absent from the public vocabulary by design
Reduced motion is a constraint resolution must satisfy, not an overridable Motion token value
